# Kindling α3.13b: A second person learns

## What is new

People gain their own skills by watching real work or accepting a kind person's evidence-backed offer. Telling supplies a hunch. Shared practice walks to a meeting and keeps earned credit across interruption and reopening. Knowledge cards distinguish unfinished observation from known crafts. History records actual discovery, learning, loss and return, with source and item links.

## What to try

Use check build 41302: [APK](../build/apk-check/kindling-41302-check.apk), 29,121,781 bytes (27.773 MiB). Start a fresh Discovery camp or inspect the labelled First flake example captured from ordinary seed 31. Follow a worker and watcher, compare Knowledge, open History and follow a source or input link. Save midway through shared practice and reopen. Use one minute/sec to watch and pause to read.

Not release-signed: built in check mode; release signing waits for the owner's passphrase.
The previous release APK remains in dist/kindling.apk. The diagnostic key cannot update that installation in place.

## What is rough

**Population spread failed.** Fireless seeds 21–40 discovered in 20/20, but only 3/20 reached three quarters of adults within the following year. RES-13 fresh seeds 42–61 were judged with them: discovery 40/40 against 32 required; spread 4/40 against 32; three routes; four-year non-flaking control zero flakes. No third set or passing retune. Same-seed diagnosis matched all forty digests: 30 accepted offers, 26 runs with none; 532 watched and five taught acquisitions. The reproduced preferred-owned-input bug is fixed with a regression: accessible shared or learner inputs are now considered first. These forty are pre-fix evidence; fresh closing seeds in α3.13e must judge the repair. Full starting-kit acceptance remains due after fire in α3.13e. Initial reserves are finite; no runtime replenishment or forced discovery.

Touched native tests: 127 cases / 1,047,216 assertions, 22.04 s. Twenty labelled practice calendars reached level 5 by day 179 and retained half-best after ten unused years; autonomous practice frequency is unproved. Source-preserving item/reservation/sight/route caches keep the captured continuation digest. Craft camps still settle serially with four workers configured.

Measured gates: first twenty plus control 131 s; fresh twenty 138 s. First-set seed speed 2.72–10.83 game years/min, weighted 4.30; overall including control 13.52. The owner's tens-of-years/min per-seed target remains unmet. APK build/verification: 580.70 s cold, 67.31 s after the offer repair, 76.97 s after sequencing the reservation reads. Routine attempts failed in 371.98 s and 203.87 s on native lint and missing LLVM command aliases; failed lint findings are fixed; changed-file lint, native source rules, 165 tool cases, documents and IDs pass separately. The reservation constructor also sequences its world read to satisfy the source-order rule. Both attempts passed native/view tests, matching proof digests, catalogue and 81 app cases. No third routine under the pace rule. Integrated self-review: once, 3 minutes. Teachers do not lend a personal tool. The diagnostic repair was reproduced and passes 27 touched cases / 11,413 assertions in 5.22 s; all T values are unchanged. Full audit and independent review wait for M3's end.

Phone frame timing, held speed, heat/battery, phone/cloud comparison and owner play answers remain unmeasured. Release signing is missing KINDLING_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE. The pinned SDK/NDK downloads needed Google's checksum-matching mirror because their original URLs returned 404.
